content.title: The Hidden Link Between Gas Prices and Slim Jim Sales
content.summary: An unusual correlation between gas prices and meat sticks is a rare boon in a tough time for the food business.  Conagra said Friday that lower prices at the pump this year have boosted convenience-store traffic—and in turn, sales of its Slim Jim brand.  CEO Sean Connolly explains: When gas prices are high, drivers are less inclined to head inside for a snack.
